[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]
== Biography ==
The marriage index names Thomas Glasgow and Elizabeth Thomson, 26 Dec 1835, Bathgate, West Lothian, Scotland. No other record establishes which Bathgate Thomas Glasgow married Elizabeth Thomson.<ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/60144/records/769143 Ancestry, Scotland, Select Marriages, 1561–1910: Thomas Glasgow and Elizabeth Thomson, 26 Dec 1835, record 60144/769143].</ref>

== Research Notes ==
The marriage index identifies the named couple. The wider identity of the Glasgow subject remains unresolved.
